description: This file defines the 'Gradients' class, which provides functionality to compute partial derivatives (gradients) of specified outputs with respect to inputs within a TensorFlow computation graph. It includes methods for creating gradient operations, handling optional attributes, and accessing gradient outputs.

classes.name: Gradients
classes.description: Provides methods to compute gradients for operations within a TensorFlow graph, including options for initial derivatives and accessing gradient outputs.

classes.name: Gradients.Options
classes.description: Encapsulates optional parameters for gradient computation, such as initial derivatives (dx).

methods.name: Gradients.create
methods.description: Creates a Gradients object by adding gradient computation ops to the graph for multiple outputs and inputs, with optional parameters.

methods.name: Gradients.create (single output version)
methods.description: Creates a Gradients object for a single output tensor, simplifying the creation process.

methods.name: Gradients.dx
methods.description: Constructs an Options object with specified initial derivatives (dx).

methods.name: dy
methods.description: Returns the list of output gradient tensors.

methods.name: dy(int)
methods.description: Returns the symbolic handle to a specific gradient output tensor by index.
